statement: Foreign investment by share acquisition under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act means a foreigner’s acquisition of shares of a Korean corporation or enterprise (including one being incorporated) for a continuing economic relationship, with the Enforcement Decree requiring an investment of at least KRW 100 million per foreign investor coupled with either ownership of at least 10 percent of the voting shares or share ownership combined with dispatching or appointing an officer (Act Article 2(1)4(a); Enforcement Decree Article 2(2)).
caveat: A registered foreign-invested company that later falls below the thresholds through a partial share transfer or capital reduction keeps foreign-investment treatment (Decree Article 2(2) proviso). The D-8 corporate-investment sojourn status is keyed to foreign-invested-company status under this Act; visa mechanics live on HiKorea and are not restated here.
